303	    def candidate(self, state: PipelineState) -> str:
304	        # Validate branch evidence again before combining anything.
305	        worker_paths = [Path(state[f"{node}_packet"]) for node in NODES]
306	        for path in worker_paths:
307	            packet = recheck_packet(read_json(path), self.policy, self.directory)
308	            if packet["gate"]["status"] != "passed":
309	                raise ValueError("Worker evidence no longer passes")
310	        saved = self.directory / "candidate.json"
311	        if saved.exists():
312	            candidate = read_json(saved)
313	        else:
314	            cwd = self.directory / "candidate"
315	            if cwd.exists():
316	                raise ValueError("Partial candidate worktree exists; inspect before recovery")
317	            subprocess.run(["git", "-C", self.plan["repository"], "worktree", "add", "--detach", str(cwd), self.plan["base_commit"]], check=True, capture_output=True)
318	            for node in NODES:
319	                commit = state["snapshots"][node]["commit"]
320	                if commit != self.plan["base_commit"]:
321	                    subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(cwd), "-c", "core.hooksPath=/dev/null", "-c", "commit.gpgsign=false", "cherry-pick", commit], env=commit_env(), check=True, capture_output=True)
322	            candidate = {"commit": git(cwd, "rev-parse", "HEAD"), "worktree": str(cwd)}
323	            save_json(saved, candidate)
324	        candidate_paths = []
325	        for node in NODES:
326	            attempt = self.attempt("candidate", node)
327	            packet = verify_revision(self.directory, self.plan, self.policy, node, candidate["commit"],
328	                                     changed_files(Path(candidate["worktree"]), self.plan["base_commit"]),
329	                                     state["snapshots"][node]["session_id"], phase="candidate", attempt=attempt)
330	            path = self.directory / "verification" / "candidate" / node / str(attempt) / "packet.json"
331	            self.event(f"candidate_{node}", packet["gate"]["status"], f"Combined revision {candidate['commit']}")
332	            if packet["gate"]["status"] != "passed":
333	                raise RuntimeError(f"Combined candidate failed {node} checks; see {path}")
334	            candidate_paths.append(path)
335	        bundle = {"run_id": self.plan["run_id"], "base_commit": self.plan["base_commit"],
336	                  "candidate_commit": candidate["commit"], "policy_sha256": policy_digest(self.policy),
337	                  "snapshots": state["snapshots"],
338	                  "packets": [{"path": str(path), "sha256": digest_file(path)} for path in worker_paths + candidate_paths]}
339	        path = self.directory / "review-bundle.json"
340	        drill_path = self.directory / "failure-drill.json"
341	        if drill_path.exists():
342	            before = read_json(drill_path)["native_before"]
343	            after = self.native_evidence()
344	            audit = {"run_id": self.plan["run_id"], "native_before": before, "native_after": after,
345	                     "workers_with_changed_launch_evidence": [node for node in NODES if before[node] != after[node]],
346	                     "verification_attempts": {node: sorted(int(item.name) for item in (self.directory / "verification" / "worker" / node).iterdir() if item.is_dir() and item.name.isdigit()) for node in NODES},
347	                     "scope": "Pipeline-issued sessions; native launch times/counts are null when unavailable. Out-of-band manual restarts are not certified."}
348	            save_json(self.directory / "failure-report.json", audit)
349	            bundle["failure_drill"] = audit
350	        save_json(path, bundle)
351	        return str(path)
352	
353	    def validate_bundle(self) -> tuple[dict, str]:
354	        path = self.directory / "review-bundle.json"
355	        bundle = read_json(path)
356	        if bundle["run_id"] != self.plan["run_id"] or bundle["policy_sha256"] != policy_digest(self.policy):
357	            raise ValueError("Bundle identity/policy changed")
358	        for reference in bundle["packets"]:
359	            packet_path = Path(reference["path"]).resolve()
360	            if not packet_path.is_relative_to(self.directory) or digest_file(packet_path) != reference["sha256"]:
361	                raise ValueError("Review evidence changed")
362	            packet = recheck_packet(read_json(packet_path), self.policy, self.directory)
363	            if packet["gate"]["status"] != "passed":
364	                raise ValueError("Review artifact missing, changed or failing")
365	        return bundle, digest_file(path)
366	
367	    def validate_review(self, review: dict, require_approved: bool = True) -> None:
368	        bundle, digest = self.validate_bundle()
369	        check_review(review, bundle, digest, require_approved=require_approved)
370	
371	    def integrate(self, approved: str) -> str:
372	        bundle, digest = self.validate_bundle()
373	        review = read_json(self.directory / "review.json")
374	        self.validate_review(review)
375	        if approved != digest:
376	            raise ValueError("Approval references stale evidence")
377	        repo = Path(self.plan["repository"])
378	        candidate = bundle["candidate_commit"]
379	        intent = self.directory / "integration-intent.json"
380	        if git(repo, "symbolic-ref", "--short", "HEAD") != self.plan["source_branch"]:
381	            raise ValueError("Source branch changed")
382	        if git(repo, "status", "--porcelain"):
383	            raise ValueError("Source worktree is dirty; refusing integration")
384	        if intent.exists():
385	            if read_json(intent) != {"bundle_sha256": digest, "candidate_commit": candidate}:
386	                raise ValueError("Integration intent changed")
387	            if git(repo, "rev-parse", "HEAD") == candidate:
388	                return candidate
389	        if git(repo, "rev-parse", "HEAD") != self.plan["base_commit"]:
390	            raise ValueError("Source advanced since preparation; rebase/review explicitly")
391	        save_json(intent, {"bundle_sha256": digest, "candidate_commit": candidate})
392	        subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(repo), "-c", "core.hooksPath=/dev/null", "merge", "--ff-only", candidate], check=True, capture_output=True)
393	        self.event("integrate", "succeeded", f"Fast-forwarded to {candidate}; no push performed")
394	        return candidate

397	class ExportRuntime:
398	    """Read-only view of a run directory for re-exporting run-state.json.
399	
400	    It constructs no sessions and touches no worktree, so a copied or finished
401	    run whose worktrees are gone still exports. Contradictory files are refused.
402	    """
403	
404	    def __init__(self, directory: Path):
405	        self.directory = directory.resolve()
406	        self.plan = read_json(self.directory / "plan.json")
407	        if "automatic" in self.plan:
408	            from .automatic import validate_automatic
409	            validate_automatic(self.plan)
410	        self.policy = None
411	        policy_path = self.directory / "policy.json"
412	        if policy_path.exists():
413	            self.policy = validate_pipeline_policy(read_json(policy_path))
414	            if self.plan.get("policy_sha256") != policy_digest(self.policy):
415	                raise ValueError("Pinned policy changed")
416	        review_path = self.directory / "review.json"
417	        if review_path.exists():
418	            bundle_path = self.directory / "review-bundle.json"
419	            if not bundle_path.exists():
420	                raise ValueError("review.json exists without review-bundle.json; contradictory run directory")
421	            # Packet hashes are not rechecked here; the adapter re-verifies packets itself.
422	            check_review(read_json(review_path), read_json(bundle_path), digest_file(bundle_path), require_approved=False)

425	def export_run(runtime: ExportRuntime) -> dict:
426	    """Re-export from the persisted checkpoint. Reading state never invokes a node or a session."""
427	    from types import SimpleNamespace
428	    database = runtime.directory / "pipeline.sqlite"
429	    if database.exists():
430	        with SqliteSaver.from_conn_string(str(database)) as saver:
431	            state = build_pipeline(saver, runtime).get_state({"configurable": {"thread_id": runtime.plan["run_id"]}})
432	    else:
433	        state = SimpleNamespace(values={}, next=("launch_ui", "launch_adapter"), tasks=[])  # Prepared, never started.
434	    return export_state(runtime, state)

437	def build_pipeline(checkpointer, runtime: Pipeline):
438	    def ui(_state): return {"ui": runtime.launch("ui")}
439	    def adapter(_state): return {"adapter": runtime.launch("adapter")}
440	    def handoff(_state):
441	        message = "Awaiting explicit completion signals and automatic freeze." if runtime.plan.get("automatic") else "Type in Claude terminals; provide both handoffs, then explicitly freeze."
442	        decision = interrupt({"kind": "worker_handoff", "message": message})
443	        if decision != {"freeze": True}:
444	            raise ValueError("Explicit freeze required")
445	        return {"snapshots": runtime.freeze()}
446	    def verify_ui(state): return {"ui_packet": runtime.verify("ui", state["snapshots"])}
447	    def verify_adapter(state): return {"adapter_packet": runtime.verify("adapter", state["snapshots"])}
448	    def candidate(state): return {"bundle": runtime.candidate(state)}
449	    def review(_state):
450	        _, digest = runtime.validate_bundle()
451	        if runtime.plan.get("automatic"):
452	            from .automatic import review_candidate
453	            decision = review_candidate(runtime)
454	        else:
455	            decision = interrupt({"kind": "independent_review", "bundle_sha256": digest,
456	                                  "bundle_path": str(runtime.directory / "review-bundle.json")})
457	        runtime.validate_review(decision)
458	        save_json(runtime.directory / "review.json", decision)
459	        runtime.event("review", "approved", decision["reviewer"])
460	        return {"review": decision}
461	    def approval(_state):
462	        _, digest = runtime.validate_bundle()
463	        if runtime.plan.get("automatic"):
464	            from .automatic import validate_automatic
465	            validate_automatic(runtime.plan)
466	            decision = {"approve": digest}  # Explicit run-level authority: feature branch only.
467	        else:
468	            decision = interrupt({"kind": "integration_approval", "bundle_sha256": digest,
469	                                  "message": "Approve fast-forward of source branch; no push."})
470	        if decision != {"approve": digest}:
471	            raise ValueError("Explicit exact-bundle approval required")
472	        return {"approved_bundle": digest}
473	    def integrate(state): return {"integrated_commit": runtime.integrate(state["approved_bundle"])}
474	    graph = StateGraph(PipelineState)
475	    for name, function in (("launch_ui", ui), ("launch_adapter", adapter), ("handoff", handoff),
476	                           ("verify_ui", verify_ui), ("verify_adapter", verify_adapter), ("candidate", candidate),
477	                           ("review", review), ("approval", approval), ("integrate", integrate)):
478	        graph.add_node(name, function)
479	    graph.add_edge(START, "launch_ui"); graph.add_edge(START, "launch_adapter")
480	    graph.add_edge(["launch_ui", "launch_adapter"], "handoff")
481	    graph.add_edge("handoff", "verify_ui"); graph.add_edge("handoff", "verify_adapter")
482	    graph.add_edge(["verify_ui", "verify_adapter"], "candidate")
483	    graph.add_edge("candidate", "review"); graph.add_edge("review", "approval")
484	    graph.add_edge("approval", "integrate"); graph.add_edge("integrate", END)
485	    return graph.compile(checkpointer=checkpointer)

495	            if runtime.plan.get("automatic") else "Launch workers → human handoff → isolated checks → combined checks → independent review → approval → integration")
496	    parts = ['<!doctype html><meta charset="utf-8"><title>Workflow report</title><style>body{font:16px system-ui;max-width:1100px;margin:40px auto;background:#151820;color:#eee}pre{white-space:pre-wrap}a{color:#8dcaff}img{max-width:100%}section{border:1px solid #555;padding:16px;margin:16px 0}</style>',

499	             '<h2>Timeline</h2><pre>' + html.escape(json.dumps(events, indent=2)) + '</pre>']

503	    edges = [("launch_ui", "handoff"), ("launch_adapter", "handoff"), ("handoff", "verify_ui"),

507	    for left, right in edges:

509	        svg.append(f'<line x1="{x1}" y1="{y1}" x2="{x2}" y2="{y2}" stroke="#9aa"/>')
510	    for name, (x, y) in positions.items():

512	        svg.append(f'<rect x="{x-75}" y="{y-23}" width="150" height="46" rx="8" fill="{color}" stroke="#9aa"/><text x="{x}" y="{y+5}" text-anchor="middle" fill="white" font-size="14">{name}</text>')
513	    svg.append('</svg><p>Highlighted nodes are pending. A completed launch is not a completed worker task.</p>')
514	    parts[2:2] = svg
515	    from urllib.parse import quote
516	    for path in packets:
517	        packet = read_json(path)
518	        parts.append('<section><h2>' + html.escape(str(path.relative_to(runtime.directory))) + '</h2><pre>' + html.escape(json.dumps({"gate": packet["gate"], "result": packet["result"]}, indent=2)) + '</pre>')
519	        for artifact in packet["result"]["artifacts"]:
520	            local = Path(packet["artifact_paths"][artifact["artifact_id"]]).resolve()
521	            if not local.is_relative_to(runtime.directory):
522	                continue
523	            url = quote(str(local.relative_to(runtime.directory)), safe="/")
524	            parts.append(f'<p><a href="{url}">{html.escape(artifact["artifact_id"])}</a></p>')

531	    destination = runtime.directory / "report.html"

657	                        parser.error("Review requires pending review and --review-file")
658	                    decision = read_json(args.review_file)

661	                elif args.action == "approve":

664	                    _, digest = runtime.validate_bundle()
665	                    if args.bundle_sha256 != digest:

667	                    value = Command(resume={"approve": digest})

670	                        parser.error("Reconcile requires failed launch steps")
671	                    for step in state.next:

675	                                parser.error("No durable launch intent; cannot reconcile without potentially launching a new agent")
676	                            runtime.sessions.run(node)  # Existing receipt path never starts a new process.
677	                elif args.action == "retry":

679	                        parser.error("Retry requires a failed graph step, not an interrupt/completed run")
680	                    if args.node:

682	                        if step not in state.next:

686	                    if any(step.startswith("launch_") for step in state.next):
687	                        parser.error("Launch failure requires explicit session reconciliation; do not blindly retry")
688	                if args.action != "status":
689	                    try:
690	                        graph.invoke(value, config)
691	                    finally:

693	                    if args.action == "start" and args.herdr:

698	    except (ValueError, RuntimeError, OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError) as error:

26	class InteractiveSessions(ClaudeSessions):
27	    """Native Claude background sessions, not print-mode jobs or Herdr-owned agents."""
28	
29	    def inventory(self) -> list[dict]:
30	        response = subprocess.run([self.executable, "agents", "--json"],
31	                                  capture_output=True, text=True, check=True, timeout=15)
32	        rows = json.loads(response.stdout)
33	        if not isinstance(rows, list):
34	            raise RuntimeError("Unexpected Claude inventory response")
35	        return rows
36	
37	    def launch_name(self, node: str) -> str:
38	        return f"workflow-{self.plan['run_id']}-{'reviewer' if node == REVIEW else node}"
39	
40	    def node_worktree(self, node: str) -> Path:
41	        """Workers live in the plan's worktrees; the reviewer in the run's candidate checkout."""
42	        if node == REVIEW:
43	            return self.directory / "review-worktree"
44	        return Path(self.plan["nodes"][node]["worktree"])
45	
46	    def locate(self, node: str, rows: list[dict]) -> dict | None:
47	        path = self.directory / f"{node}.interactive.json"
48	        if not path.exists():
49	            return None
50	        receipt = read_json(path)
51	        if receipt["plan_digest"] != plan_digest(self.plan):
52	            raise RuntimeError("Plan changed; cannot reconcile session")
53	        background_id = receipt.get("background_id")
54	        if not background_id:
55	            log = self.directory / f"{node}.launch.log"
56	            if not log.exists():
57	                return None
58	            # --bg assigns its own UUID. Bind the ID printed by this launch;
59	            # never adopt a guessed UUID or a name-only match.
60	            ids = set(re.findall(r"claude attach ([a-f0-9-]{8,36})\s", log.read_text(errors="replace")))
61	            if len(ids) != 1:
62	                raise RuntimeError("Missing/ambiguous native launch ID; reconcile manually")
63	            background_id = ids.pop()
64	        matches = [row for row in rows if row.get("id") == background_id]
65	        if not matches:
66	            return None
67	        if len(matches) != 1:
68	            raise RuntimeError("Ambiguous Claude session identity")
69	        row = matches[0]
70	        if row.get("kind") != "background" or Path(row.get("cwd", "")).resolve() != self.node_worktree(node).resolve() or row.get("name") != self.launch_name(node):
71	            raise RuntimeError("Claude session identity/worktree mismatch")
72	        if receipt.get("background_id") and row.get("sessionId") != receipt.get("session_id"):
73	            raise RuntimeError("Native Claude UUID changed; refusing attachment")
74	        if not isinstance(row.get("sessionId"), str) or not re.fullmatch(r"[a-f0-9-]{36}", row["sessionId"]):
75	            raise RuntimeError("Missing native Claude UUID")
76	        # `done` is a finished TURN, not a terminated terminal. Require the
77	        # native live PID as well; stale registry rows must not imply restart.
78	        if row.get("state") not in {"idle", "working", "blocked", "done"}:
79	            raise RuntimeError(f"Session is not attachable: {row.get('state')!r}; reconcile manually")
80	        pid = row.get("pid")
81	        if not isinstance(pid, int) or pid <= 0:
82	            raise RuntimeError("No live native PID; reconcile session before attaching")
83	        try:
84	            os.kill(pid, 0)
85	        except OSError as error:
86	            raise RuntimeError("Native process is unavailable; refusing implicit restart") from error
87	        return row
88	
89	    settle_seconds = 30.0
90	
91	    def settle(self, node: str) -> dict:
92	        """Bind the row created by the launch we just issued.
93	
94	        `claude --bg` exits before the native session has fully registered: the
95	        inventory row can appear without a PID for a moment. Poll for the exact
96	        row until it is attachable; identity mismatches still fail immediately
97	        and nothing is ever launched again from here.
98	        """
99	        deadline = time.monotonic() + self.settle_seconds
100	        while True:
101	            try:
102	                row = self.locate(node, self.inventory())
103	            except RuntimeError as error:
104	                if "No live native PID" not in str(error) or time.monotonic() >= deadline:
105	                    raise
106	                row = None
107	            if row is not None:
108	                return row
109	            if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
110	                raise RuntimeError("No exact matching background session after launch")
111	            time.sleep(1)
112	
113	    def reconcile(self, node: str, path: Path, receipt: dict) -> dict:
114	        """An existing receipt binds the one session this intent produced; nothing is launched again."""
115	        if receipt["plan_digest"] != plan_digest(self.plan):
116	            raise RuntimeError("Plan changed; refusing session reuse")
117	        row = self.locate(node, self.inventory())
118	        if row is None:
119	            raise RuntimeError("Existing launch cannot be reconciled; no automatic relaunch")
120	        receipt.update(status="attached_session_available", background_id=row["id"], session_id=row["sessionId"], observed_state=row["state"], native_started_at=row.get("startedAt"))
121	        receipt.pop("error", None)
122	        save_json(path, receipt)
123	        return receipt
124	
125	    def launch(self, node: str, path: Path, receipt: dict, command: list[str], cwd: Path) -> dict:
126	        """Run the short `claude --bg` helper once, then bind the exact row it created."""
127	        env = {key: value for key, value in os.environ.items() if not key.startswith("HERDR_")}
128	        try:
129	            # This command creates Claude's own persistent terminal, then exits.
130	            # Killing this short helper is NOT evidence that the session stopped.
131	            with (self.directory / f"{node}.launch.log").open("w") as log:
132	                try:
133	                    result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=cwd, env=env, stdout=log,
134	                                            stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, text=True, timeout=self.timeout)
135	                finally:
136	                    log.flush()
137	                    os.fsync(log.fileno())
138	            if result.returncode != 0:
139	                raise RuntimeError(f"Claude background launch exited {result.returncode}; inspect launch log")
140	            row = self.settle(node)
141	            receipt.update(status="attached_session_available", background_id=row["id"], session_id=row["sessionId"], observed_state=row["state"], native_started_at=row.get("startedAt"))
142	        except BaseException as error:
143	            receipt.update(status="needs_reconciliation", error=str(error))
144	            raise
145	        finally:
146	            save_json(path, receipt)
147	        return receipt
148	
149	    def run(self, node: str) -> dict:
150	        if node not in NODES or self.plan.get("mode") != "interactive":
151	            raise ValueError("Expected an interactive worker plan")
152	        info = self.plan["nodes"][node]
153	        path = self.directory / f"{node}.interactive.json"
154	        if path.exists():
155	            return self.reconcile(node, path, read_json(path))
156	        cwd = Path(info["worktree"])
157	        if git(cwd, "rev-parse", "HEAD") != self.plan["base_commit"] or git(cwd, "status", "--porcelain"):
158	            raise RuntimeError("Worktree changed since preparation")
159	        # Native IDs do not exist until launch. Reject conflicting terminal names.
160	        if any(row.get("name") == self.launch_name(node) for row in self.inventory()):
161	            raise RuntimeError("Unowned session already exists with this launch name")
162	        receipt = {"node_id": node, "session_id": None, "launch_token": info["session_id"], "plan_digest": plan_digest(self.plan),
163	                   "worktree": str(cwd), "base_commit": self.plan["base_commit"],
164	                   "status": "launching", "attempt": 1, "launcher_invocations": 1,
165	                   "launch_requested_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()}
166	        save_json(path, receipt)
167	        automatic = bool(self.plan.get("automatic"))
168	        if automatic:
169	            from .automatic import validate_automatic
170	            validate_automatic(self.plan)
171	        tools = "Read,Glob,Grep,Edit,Write" if self.plan["allow_edits"] else "Read,Glob,Grep"
172	        if automatic:
173	            tools += ",Bash"
174	        prompt = ("You are a workflow worker in your own worktree. A human can type directly into this terminal. "
175	                  "Do not launch agents, commit, merge, push or modify shared contracts. Stay within this worktree. "
176	                  "Report changed files, checks actually executed, and open assumptions. "
177	                  "Completion of a turn is not workflow approval.\n\n" + info["task"])
178	        if automatic:
179	            from .automatic import completion_prompt
180	            prompt += completion_prompt(self.directory, self.plan, node)
181	        # The exact prompt is run evidence (the viewer shows it); it is private like the receipts.
182	        write_private(self.directory / f"{node}.prompt.txt", prompt)
183	        command = [self.executable, "--bg", "--name", self.launch_name(node),
184	                   "--safe-mode", "--strict-mcp-config", "--mcp-config", '{"mcpServers":{}}',
185	                   "--tools", tools, "--permission-mode", "bypassPermissions" if automatic else "manual"]
186	        if automatic:
187	            command.append("--dangerously-skip-permissions")
188	        command.append(prompt)
189	        return self.launch(node, path, receipt, command, cwd)

191	    def run_reviewer(self, prompt: str, launch_token: str, candidate_commit: str) -> dict:
192	        """Launch (or reconcile) the one native reviewer session for this candidate.
193	
194	        The reviewer reads the candidate checkout and the run directory; its only
195	        permitted write is the completion file the controller later validates.
196	        """
197	        if self.plan.get("mode") != "interactive":
198	            raise ValueError("Expected an interactive run plan")
199	        path = self.directory / "review.interactive.json"
200	        if path.exists():
201	            return self.reconcile(REVIEW, path, read_json(path))
202	        cwd = self.node_worktree(REVIEW)
203	        if not cwd.is_dir():
204	            raise RuntimeError("Review worktree is missing; the review node creates it before launching a reviewer")
205	        if git(cwd, "rev-parse", "HEAD") != candidate_commit or git(cwd, "status", "--porcelain"):
206	            raise RuntimeError("Review worktree is not at the clean candidate commit")
207	        if any(row.get("name") == self.launch_name(REVIEW) for row in self.inventory()):
208	            raise RuntimeError("Unowned session already exists with this launch name")
209	        receipt = {"node_id": REVIEW, "session_id": None, "launch_token": launch_token, "plan_digest": plan_digest(self.plan),
210	                   "worktree": str(cwd), "base_commit": self.plan["base_commit"], "candidate_commit": candidate_commit,
211	                   "status": "launching", "attempt": 1, "launcher_invocations": 1,
212	                   "launch_requested_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()}
213	        save_json(path, receipt)
214	        write_private(self.directory / "review.prompt.txt", prompt)
215	        # Claude permission rules spell absolute paths as //absolute/path, and file writes are
216	        # governed by the Edit rule family (Write, Edit, NotebookEdit): under dontAsk a rule
217	        # spelled Write(...) never matches and every write is denied (seen live), while
218	        # Edit(//<path>) allows exactly that file and keeps every other write denied.
219	        completion = str(self.directory / "review.completion.json").lstrip("/")
220	        # --tools, --allowedTools and --add-dir are variadic: any of them directly before the
221	        # positional prompt would swallow it (the session would start idle, without a task).
222	        # The prompt therefore follows --permission-mode, which takes exactly one value.
223	        command = [self.executable, "--bg", "--name", self.launch_name(REVIEW),
224	                   "--safe-mode", "--strict-mcp-config", "--mcp-config", '{"mcpServers":{}}',
225	                   "--tools", "Read,Glob,Grep,Write", "--allowedTools", f"Edit(//{completion})",
226	                   "--add-dir", str(self.directory), "--permission-mode", "dontAsk", prompt]
227	        return self.launch(REVIEW, path, receipt, command, cwd)

229	    def status(self) -> dict:
230	        rows = self.inventory()
231	        result = {}
232	        nodes = NODES + ((REVIEW,) if (self.directory / "review.interactive.json").exists() else ())
233	        for node in nodes:
234	            path = self.directory / f"{node}.interactive.json"
235	            row = self.locate(node, rows)
236	            result[node] = {"receipt": read_json(path) if path.exists() else None,
237	                            "current_session": row, "verified": False}
238	        return result

246	def build_interactive_graph(checkpointer, sessions: InteractiveSessions):
247	    def ui(_state: SessionState):
248	        return {"ui": sessions.run("ui")}
249	
250	    def adapter(_state: SessionState):
251	        return {"adapter": sessions.run("adapter")}
252	
253	    def handoff(state: SessionState):
254	        interrupt({"kind": "interactive_workers_active", "run_id": state["run_id"],
255	                   "message": "Type directly in the Claude panels. Idle is not completion. Explicit evidence/review handoff is still required."})
256	        raise RuntimeError("Verification/integration handoff is not implemented yet")
257	
258	    graph = StateGraph(SessionState)
259	    graph.add_node("launch_ui", ui)
260	    graph.add_node("launch_adapter", adapter)
261	    graph.add_node("human_handoff", handoff)
262	    graph.add_edge(START, "launch_ui")
263	    graph.add_edge(START, "launch_adapter")
264	    graph.add_edge(["launch_ui", "launch_adapter"], "human_handoff")
265	    graph.add_edge("human_handoff", END)
266	    return graph.compile(checkpointer=checkpointer)

269	def require_shell(pane_id: str, settle_seconds: float = 10.0) -> None:
270	    """Only type into a pane whose sole foreground process is its own idle shell.
271	
272	    A pane Herdr just created reports no shell, or a shell still running its
273	    startup files, for a moment. Poll briefly for the idle-shell state; a pane
274	    that is still occupied at the deadline is refused, never typed into.
275	    """
276	    deadline = time.monotonic() + settle_seconds
277	    while True:
278	        process = herdr("pane", "process-info", "--pane", pane_id)["result"]["process_info"]
279	        foreground = process.get("foreground_processes", [])
280	        shell_pid = process.get("shell_pid")
281	        if shell_pid and len(foreground) == 1 and foreground[0].get("pid") == shell_pid:
282	            return
283	        if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
284	            raise RuntimeError(f"Pane {pane_id} is occupied; refusing to type an attach command into it")
285	        time.sleep(0.5)

288	def attach_panels(sessions: InteractiveSessions, reuse_observers: Path | None = None) -> dict:
289	    directory = sessions.directory
290	    mapping_path = directory / "terminals.json"
291	    if mapping_path.exists():
292	        raise RuntimeError("Terminal mappings already exist; use attach-one inside an available terminal to reconnect")
293	    rows = sessions.inventory()
294	    for node in NODES:
295	        receipt = read_json(directory / f"{node}.interactive.json")
296	        if receipt["plan_digest"] != plan_digest(sessions.plan) or sessions.locate(node, rows) is None:
297	            raise RuntimeError("Cannot attach an unverified/missing session")
298	    caller = herdr("pane", "current", "--current")["result"]["pane"]
299	    source = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
300	    if reuse_observers:
301	        mapping = read_json(reuse_observers)
302	        if set(mapping) != set(NODES) or any(value.get("mode") != "read-only-observer" for value in mapping.values()):
303	            raise RuntimeError("Can only replace explicitly identified read-only observer panels")
304	        if len({value["pane_id"] for value in mapping.values()}) != len(NODES):
305	            raise RuntimeError("Observer pane identities must be distinct")
306	        tabs = set()
307	        for entry in mapping.values():
308	            pane = herdr("pane", "get", entry["pane_id"])["result"]["pane"]
309	            if pane["workspace_id"] != caller["workspace_id"] or pane["tab_id"] != entry["tab_id"] or pane["tab_id"] == caller["tab_id"]:
310	                raise RuntimeError("Observer pane moved or is not in a dedicated tab in this workspace")
311	            require_shell(entry["pane_id"])
312	            tabs.add(pane["tab_id"])
313	        if len(tabs) != 1:
314	            raise RuntimeError("Workers must share a dedicated workflow tab")
315	        # Consume the old observer mapping before any attach command is sent.
316	        for entry in mapping.values():
317	            entry.update(mode="transferred-to-interactive", transferred_to=str(directory))
318	        save_json(reuse_observers, mapping)
319	        save_json(mapping_path, mapping)
320	        herdr("tab", "rename", next(iter(tabs)), f"Workflow: {directory.name}")
321	    else:
322	        created = herdr("tab", "create", "--workspace", caller["workspace_id"], "--cwd", str(source),
323	                        "--label", f"Workflow: {directory.name}", "--no-focus")["result"]
324	        mapping = {"ui": {"pane_id": created["root_pane"]["pane_id"], "tab_id": created["tab"]["tab_id"], "mode": "allocated"}}
325	        save_json(mapping_path, mapping)
326	        split = herdr("pane", "split", "--pane", mapping["ui"]["pane_id"], "--direction", "right", "--cwd", str(source), "--no-focus")["result"]
327	        mapping["adapter"] = {"pane_id": split["pane"]["pane_id"], "tab_id": created["tab"]["tab_id"], "mode": "allocated"}
328	        save_json(mapping_path, mapping)
329	    # A reviewer that already exists (attach after the review node started) gets its pane now;
330	    # otherwise the review node adds it through attach_reviewer_panel when it launches.
331	    if (directory / "review.interactive.json").exists() and sessions.locate(REVIEW, rows) is not None:
332	        allocate_reviewer_pane(mapping, mapping_path)
333	    for node, entry in mapping.items():
334	        attach_pane(sessions, mapping, mapping_path, node, sessions.locate(node, rows)["sessionId"])
335	    return mapping

338	def allocate_reviewer_pane(mapping: dict, mapping_path: Path) -> None:
339	    source = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
340	    split = herdr("pane", "split", "--pane", mapping["adapter"]["pane_id"], "--direction", "right", "--cwd", str(source), "--no-focus")["result"]
341	    mapping[REVIEW] = {"pane_id": split["pane"]["pane_id"], "tab_id": mapping["adapter"]["tab_id"], "mode": "allocated"}
342	    save_json(mapping_path, mapping)

345	def attach_pane(sessions: InteractiveSessions, mapping: dict, mapping_path: Path, node: str, session_id: str) -> None:
346	    source = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
347	    entry = mapping[node]
348	    require_shell(entry["pane_id"])
349	    herdr("pane", "rename", entry["pane_id"], f"Claude: {'reviewer' if node == REVIEW else node}")
350	    # Re-check identity in the actual attachment process immediately before exec.
351	    command = shlex.join([sys.executable, "-m", "workflow.interactive", "attach-one", str(sessions.directory), "--node", node])
352	    command = f"cd {shlex.quote(str(source))} && {command}"
353	    entry.update(mode="attach_requested", session_id=session_id)
354	    save_json(mapping_path, mapping)
355	    herdr("pane", "run", entry["pane_id"], command)

358	def attach_reviewer_panel(sessions: InteractiveSessions) -> dict:
359	    """Add the `Claude: reviewer` pane beside the workers' panes once the reviewer session exists."""
360	    directory = sessions.directory
361	    mapping_path = directory / "terminals.json"
362	    if not mapping_path.exists():
363	        raise RuntimeError("No terminal mappings; attach the worker panes before the reviewer pane")
364	    mapping = read_json(mapping_path)
365	    if not set(NODES) <= set(mapping):
366	        raise RuntimeError("Terminal mappings lack the worker panes; refusing to add a reviewer pane")
367	    if REVIEW in mapping:
368	        raise RuntimeError("Reviewer pane already allocated; use attach-one --node review inside an available terminal to reconnect")
369	    receipt_path = directory / "review.interactive.json"
370	    if not receipt_path.exists():
371	        raise RuntimeError("No reviewer session receipt; nothing to attach")
372	    if read_json(receipt_path)["plan_digest"] != plan_digest(sessions.plan):
373	        raise RuntimeError("Plan changed; cannot attach the reviewer")
374	    rows = sessions.inventory()
375	    row = sessions.locate(REVIEW, rows)
376	    if row is None:
377	        raise RuntimeError("Cannot attach an unverified/missing reviewer session")
378	    allocate_reviewer_pane(mapping, mapping_path)
379	    attach_pane(sessions, mapping, mapping_path, REVIEW, row["sessionId"])
380	    return mapping

384	    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
385	    parser.add_argument("action", choices=["prepare", "run", "status", "attach", "attach-one"])

I'll present the structured findings next, listing those four gaps.

findings.title: Post-wait reviewer identity/independence re-check is untested and unfalsifiable with FakeSessions
findings.evidence: Mutation on a scratch copy: deleted the four lines in `_accept_native` (`row = runtime.sessions.locate(...)`, `worker_ids = ...`, `if row is None or row.get("sessionId") != receipt.get("session_id") or receipt.get("session_id") in worker_ids: raise RuntimeError("Reviewer identity changed or is not independent; refusing the verdict")`) and ran NativeReviewerGraphTests + AutomaticGraphTests + ReviewCompletionTests: 18/18 pass. No test file references "identity changed or"/"not independent" (grep). FakeSessions.inventory builds every row from the receipts on disk with the constant REVIEWER_UUID, and locate matches on that same receipt session_id, so no graph test can ever make the live row differ from the receipt or equal a worker UUID. PRD_REVIEWER_PANE §3 table ("Independence: reviewer UUID must differ from both worker UUIDs; verified from claude agents --json"), design spec §3.3 ("re-check reviewer identity (locate row sessionId == receipt session_id and not equal to either worker session id)") and HANDOFF §1 ("identity/independence/worktree/evidence re-checks") all claim this check.
findings.failure: Reviewer session swapped or hijacked between writing review.completion.json and the controller's poll (row sessionId != receipt session_id), or a worker session id reused as the reviewer: with the check removed the verdict is accepted. For a blocked verdict `_decide` writes review.json before any independence check, so a non-independent blocked review is persisted; for an approved verdict only check_review's receipt-vs-bundle comparison remains, never the live `claude agents --json` row. No test turns red for any of this.
findings.fix: Add knobs to FakeSessions (e.g. `reviewer_row_session_id` override and `reviewer_vanishes_after_file`) so a NativeReviewerGraphTests case can make locate("review") return a different UUID, a worker UUID from the bundle snapshots, or None after the completion file exists; assert RuntimeError "identity changed or is not independent", receipt status blocked, stop_reviewer called once, no review.json, second drive does not relaunch.

findings.title: Worktree-unchanged and evidence-unchanged re-checks after the reviewer wait have no test (native or print)
findings.evidence: Mutation on a scratch copy: deleted `if git(cwd, "rev-parse", "HEAD") != bundle["candidate_commit"] or git(cwd, "status", "--porcelain"): raise RuntimeError("Reviewer worktree changed")` and `if runtime.validate_bundle()[1] != digest or digest_file(patch) != receipt["patch_sha256"]: raise RuntimeError("Evidence changed during review")` from `_accept_native`; NativeReviewerGraphTests + AutomaticGraphTests 14/14 pass. `git show HEAD:workflow/test_automatic.py | grep` shows these strings were never tested in the print path either; HANDOFF §1 and §4 present them as part of the native accept path with "behavioural reds per increment".
findings.failure: review.diff rewritten or review-worktree dirtied/moved to another commit while the reviewer runs (e.g. an operator resumes the transcript and edits): the completion file is still accepted and review.json/automatic-review.json record `succeeded` against evidence the reviewer did not see; no test detects the missing guard.
findings.fix: Reuse the `reviewer_mutate` hook style: a FakeSessions callback invoked in run_reviewer after writing the completion file that (a) touches a file inside `<run>/review-worktree`, (b) rewrites review.diff; assert the exact RuntimeError message, receipt blocked, stop called, review.json absent.

findings.title: Print-mode recording of finding `worker`/`requirement` is untested: the fake print reviewer always returns `findings: []`
findings.evidence: Mutation on a scratch copy: changed REVIEW_SCHEMA finding `required` to `["severity", "message", "disposition"]` and removed the `worker`/`requirement` properties; PrintReviewerGraphTests + CompletionTests 18/18 pass. The fake print executable prints `"structured_output": {"verdict": verdict, "findings": []}` in every test, so the extended schema and the `worker`/`requirement` values never reach review.json or the export's `review.findings` in print mode. HANDOFF §1 claims `_review_print` is "now also recording worker/requirement"; design spec §3.3 says both are required in REVIEW_SCHEMA.
findings.failure: REVIEW_SCHEMA regresses (fields dropped or made optional, or enum widened to accept e.g. "reviewer"): print-mode reviews persist findings without the link fields, the export's `review.findings[].worker/requirement` are null, and slice C's finding-to-task links silently never appear for print-mode runs. All Python tests stay green.
findings.fix: Make the fake executable read an optional findings JSON file (like `review-verdict`) and add a PrintReviewerGraphTests case that supplies a finding with worker/requirement and asserts review.json and run-state.json carry them; add a negative case (finding without `worker`) asserting "Reviewer did not succeed"/schema failure and receipt blocked.

findings.title: "A missing pane never fails the review" and the reviewer launch-failure receipt (`needs_reconciliation`) have no test
findings.evidence: Mutation on a scratch copy: (a) in Pipeline.launch_reviewer removed the try/except so a failing attach_reviewer_panel propagates (guard `terminals.json` + HERDR_ENV==1 kept); (b) in `_review_native` replaced the `except BaseException as error: receipt.update(status="needs_reconciliation", error=...); save_json(...); raise` with a bare re-raise. Ran workflow.test_automatic, test_interactive, test_export, test_feature_launch: 73/73 pass. grep of the test files for "Reviewer pane" and "needs_reconciliation" finds only the worker/interactive receipt cases, none for the review node. PRD_REVIEW_VISIBILITY decisions log: "a missing pane never fails the review (slice A)"; HANDOFF §1: "launch_reviewer (events with the reviewer UUID, best-effort pane)" and "automatic-review.json ... needs_reconciliation" on launch failure.
findings.failure: (a) Under Herdr with terminals.json present, a pane allocation error (pane occupied, Herdr RPC failure) raises out of the review node: the run fails after the reviewer session was already launched, and no offline test notices the lost best-effort guarantee. (b) A `claude --bg` launch that times out or exits non-zero leaves automatic-review.json at `launching` with no error string; the RUNBOOK's reconciliation guidance keyed on `needs_reconciliation` does not apply and no test asserts the status.
findings.fix: Unit test on Pipeline.launch_reviewer with a SimpleNamespace sessions whose run_reviewer returns a receipt, terminals.json present, `patch.dict(os.environ, {"HERDR_ENV": "1"})`, and `patch("workflow.pipeline.attach_reviewer_panel", side_effect=RuntimeError(...))`: assert the receipt is returned and an event "Reviewer pane not attached" exists. Graph test with `patch.object(f.runtime, "launch_reviewer", side_effect=RuntimeError)`: assert automatic-review.json status `needs_reconciliation` with the error, no review.interactive.json/review.json, and that a second drive raises without calling run_reviewer.
